lines.speaker: quarter_regular
lines.text: Sit down. Nobody up here discusses the treaty, which is precisely how you can tell that everybody up here wrote part of it.

lines.speaker: quarter_regular
lines.text: Word in the bar is that ownership is being renegotiated somewhere nobody can point to. And everyone is extremely calm about it, which is how I know it's true — panic is for things people think they can still affect.

lines.speaker: quarter_regular
lines.text: Everything's going through on schedule and nobody is nervous. That is the worst sign there is. Nervous means somebody still thinks they might lose.

lines.speaker: quarter_regular
lines.text: Your friend in the habit has been getting looks all evening. This is not a century that's kind to the devout, and it's not that they're hostile. It's that they think she's a costume.

lines.speaker: quarter_regular
lines.text: The consortium's people talk about their model the way my father talked about his dog. Fondly. Proprietorially. As a thing that is good and is theirs. That should frighten me considerably more than it does.
